name: NemNet
name_long: NemNet – Danish Fiber Internet Service Provider
notes:
NemNet (AS198473) is a Danish fiber broadband Internet Service Provider (ISP), delivering FTTH connectivity to residential and business customers across Denmark.

We operate our own BGP network with multiple upstream providers and interconnection points.

NemNet welcomes settlement-free peering with other ISPs, content delivery networks (CDNs), and network operators at mutually accessible interconnection locations.

Both public and private peering arrangements are considered.

For peering enquiries, please contact peering@nemnet.dk.
